reviews.title: Nobody Does UI worse than the UFC
reviews.text: Between the UFC website, the UFC app, and even the paramount fight selector, NOBODY does User Interface worse than the ufc. The app is lousy, the fighter insights are weak, and the user friendliness is just overall horrible. The website is the same way, ESPN's website has always had better options for viewing ufc events/fighters/stats. It should be no surprise I suppose - the company isn't even willing to pay their fighters decent earnings. No shock they're cutting corners elsewhere

reviews.title: Don’t  waste your money
reviews.text: I purchased my subscription in August of last year. Everything was great until January of this year. At that point, no more fights or new events became available, which was the reason I bought the subscription. I contacted UFC Fight Pass, but they didn't offer any solution, telling me I had to escalate the issue with Apple. Apple doesn't offer a refund option after so much time has passed. In short, I feel robbed because I'm not getting the service I paid for, and I don't have the option to get my money back. UFC isn't responding, and Apple doesn't offer a solution because the subscription has been active for so long.

reviews.title: Last thing UFC updates is the app
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for a couple years and I can never find updated info on the app itself.  The fight cards are not updated. The fighter stats and standings are not updated.  You can use google and be weeks or months ahead of this app. There’s no way Dana knows how screwed up it is.

2025 update: not any better, can’t even find the dates of upcoming events.  The app just says - up next - we have to leave the app to find out the date. Who’s monitoring this app? They need replaced.

reviews.title: If you got the app for watching UFC fight night don’t
reviews.text:
I subscribed to UFC Fight Pass for a full year just to watch UFC 322, and the service completely failed me. I paid, logged in, waited for the event… and the stream wouldn’t work at all. Very disappointing for something I specifically purchased to watch live fights.

On top of that, the app has serious issues on MacBook you can’t even get full screen to work properly. For a premium service, the experience should be smooth and reliable, but it wasn’t.

Really hoping UFC improves the platform, because right now it’s not worth the money.
